findings.title: setRoute requires only swap_type != 0 on executed hops; Router NG v1.1 dispatches 1..8 and reverts 'Bad swap type' otherwise, so a swap_type >= 9 route is stored as valid and reverts every harvest that sells that token
findings.rootCause: Executed-hop swapParams validation checks presence (swap_type != 0) rather than the immutable router's accepted range (1..8). i/j/pool_type/n_coins and executed-hop pools are unconstrained by explicit story-007 out-of-scope; the swap_type range is NOT in that out-of-scope list.

instances.note: says executed rows 'dispatch on a real swap_type', which the check does not establish (LOCAL-006)
test-side blind spot tracked under Q-06 sub-issue 4

findings.impactSummary: Liveness only. Every harvest delivering that token reverts Error('Bad swap type') (decodable via harvest.sh's generic Error(string) path) until the owner re-sets the route or callers exempt the strategy. Atomic: invariants confirm harvester and caller balances unchanged; no strand, no value at risk.
findings.classification: owner footgun of low surprise (Law 3): owner copies a route from tooling targeting Router NG v1.2 (type 9 = ERC4626) or slips a field; the new 'params consistent with path' check reads as having validated it.
findings.relationToM01: Not an incomplete fix of M-01: M-01's root was a SILENT strand; this residual is fail-loud. Distinct rootCauseClass and mitigation. Story-faithfulness: story-007 Goal sentence claims more than its spec block delivers; recorded here as a cross-reference, not a separate F (no double-count).
findings.recommendation: Bound executed swap_type to 1..8 (`if (swapParams[h][2] - 1 >= 8) revert InvalidRouteSwapParams(h)`) tied to the immutable router version, and make MockCurveRouter revert outside 1..8; or document that setRoute validates path shape only and operators should eth_call router.exchange before registering.
findings.proposedSeverity: QA (code-scan qa; profile local-low; patterns potential-low; all agree fail-loud)
